status: Fixed before complete acquisition, semantic review and model outputs
sampling: After extraction, internal dedup and old TRAIN/exposed DEV overlap audit: two SHA-ranked units in each edition x length stratum (<=256, >256 body tokens), eight editions, up to32 units; missing strata are reported, never silently filled based on appearance.
reading: Read every selected unit in full; source headings, paragraph ordinals and license scope preserved. Record accept/hold/exclude, reasons, factual/date/context/quotation risks. Assistant reading is not independent human evaluation.
extraction_gate: No observed omitted-material bridging, altered word order, fake window EOS, invalid UTF8/BPE recovery, rights/privacy severe issue in selected units. Any implementation problem stops admission pending documented correction and new version; no hidden retry or claim of original gate success.
quality_gate: At least28 of32 fully reviewed units must be coherent, grammatically usable multi-sentence prose without missing necessary context. Zero severe unhandled rights/privacy/corruption cases. If fewer than32 available, no automatic percentage-based pass.
specific_unit_handling: Hold problematic sampled units and objectively identified affected families; no language model-generated repair. Do not extrapolate sample certification to every source fact or human-only authorship.
dataset_policy: One deterministic pass over admitted independent units. Do not repeat a small pool to reach a token quota. Environmental-policy genre and correlated annual reports reported explicitly.
automatic_exclusions: paragraphs.py frozen SHA at actual extraction; candidates remain private until quality and rights decision. No changing rules to force a failed review gate to pass.
training_requirements: Both an adequate unused eligible short-caption control and diverse original paragraph units, fixed source-held-out paragraph DEV, exact target matching, numerical/resume and persistent storage audits. Source/date/length/EOS confounds disclosed.
formal_adoption: No-Go without actual generation ability and unchanged adoption standards; this gate permits exploratory learning only.
repair: Remove EOS at parent-heading to child-heading transitions. Do not resample or relax gate.
